disclosures.title: missing the week
disclosures.body: Atomos is Week 5 of 9. Missing it means waiting roughly two months for the next cycle. The adapter can also be bought from Cavalero for platinum, but only during the week it's live, and it still comes with the install resources owed.

rows.label: Complete Incarnon Evolutions
rows.note: Evo II: 100 kills in Incarnon Form; Evo III: 30 kills with 4+ status effects; each grants 5,000 affinity

conditions: Charging needs 21 weakpoint hits; MOA backpacks, corpses and invulnerable targets don't count, and multishot doesn't speed it up.

Evo III (4+ statuses) is the common sticking point: prime with Citrine's Prismatic Gem, Voruna's Fangs of Raksh, Secondary Encumber, or unmodded Cedo alt-fire, and lower Ability Strength so the priming ability doesn't steal the kill.
bonuses: Many players install the Genesis purely for the Evo II-IV base-stat boosts to the beam and ignore the transformed Blast-grenade form entirely.

disclosures.title: the Incarnon form knocks you down
disclosures.body: A widely-upvoted thread was about self-ragdoll from the Incarnon grenades. The fix is Primed Sure Footed, or just don't fire it point-blank.
